generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for

Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should have valid Class-3 and above Registered Electrical Contractor License issued from Inspectorate of Electricity.
The bidder should submit the GST/PAN Registration Certificate.

Tenderer in their name should submit annual turnover certificate any two years from last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 of Rs.7.62 Lakhs in each year. Turn over certificate should be mandatorily certified from charted accountant and mention UDIN number is compulsory, otherwise it will be subjected to rejection

Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka /any Govt. Agency/ULBs/PSU. The bidder should submit self declaration for the same.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Installation of CCTV cameras at the offices of Zones 1, 2, and 3 of the Shivamogga City Corporation and at other corporation office buildings.

itemList.description: Supplying and fixing of outdoor IP bullet CCTV camera with rugged design with weather resistance of IP66 protection having minimum resolution of 5MP supported with night vision facility and motion sensor facility, Camera shall have angle adjustment (tilt) and digital zoom up to 8X a. The camera shall support NVR technology and PoE technology. The camera shall be supplied with all necessary accessories like Brackets, Power adaptor, connectors, nuts, bolts etc. The CCTV Shall comply with guidelines of BIS 13252 (Part-I). The product shall be provided with warranty of 2 years against any manufacture defects, repairs and service.
Supplying and installing Outdoor Surveillance Hard Disk of Capacity 4TB with warranty of 2 years against any manufacturing defects.

Supplying and installing of Network Video Recorder (NVR) with metallic housing IP 66 and shall have 16 Channel input having SATA interface and USB interface. The product shall be provided with warranty of 01 years against any manufacture defects, repairs and service.
Supplying and drawing UTP-CAT 6E LAN cable.

Supplying and installing of 32 " LED monitor suitable for 24/7 CCTV surveillance with full HD display and with HDMI and VGA ports and with all cables and providing warranty of 12 Months against any repairs and defects .
Supplying & Fixing of switch mounting rack with power manager &.Cable manager. 4U with 450mm depth
